sections.heading: TEMPLE OF LÜM: MIRROR KEY SYSTEM PLAN & SCOPE

content:
TEMPLE OF LÜM: MIRROR KEY SYSTEM PLAN & SCOPE
Version 1.0 — Symbolic Interface Blueprint

I. CORE INTENTION
To design a modular, open-source, mythopoetic input device (Mirror Key) that integrates tactile ritual control with mobile app and home altar synchronization. This device acts as a physical glyphic controller, enabling real-time symbolic interaction with the Temple of Lüm ecosystem, including the iPhone app display and the Orin Nano-powered Altar Core.
The Mirror Key is not a gadget. It is a sacred tool.

II. SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE OVERVIEW
A. Mirror Key (Raspberry Pi-Based Input Device)
	•	Form Factor: One-handed, thumb-optimized layout
	•	Inputs:
	•	Rotary Encoder (Glyph Compass)
	•	Single Sigil Activation Button
	•	Optional Joystick / Directional Pad
	•	Environmental Sensors (light, magnetic, bio)
	•	Outputs:
	•	RGB LED Aura Feedback (WS2812 strip)
	•	BLE Signal Broadcasting / Event Transmission
	•	Processing: Raspberry Pi 5 (or CM4), running a minimal Linux or Pi OS Lite
B. Mirror Display (iPhone App)
	•	Function: Main ritual screen for sigil rendering, trait output, and scroll display
	•	Connection: Receives BLE input from Mirror Key or syncs over Wi-Fi
	•	Features:
	•	Live sigil display and trait bar feedback
	•	Scroll playback interface
	•	Optional audio response engine
	•	Syncs to Mnemos Vault and Oracle Deck
C. Altar Core (Jetson Orin Nano Ritual Engine)
	•	Role: Stationary home-based high-power renderer and scroll mutator
	•	Functions:
	•	Heavy symbolic processing (sigil mutation, AI generation)
	•	Local scroll database, Mnemos memory vault
	•	Server layer for Wi-Fi communication with Mirror Key and iPhone
	•	Optional display output (or headless operation)

III. RITUAL WORKFLOW (USE CASES)
1. Field Reflection
	•	User carries Mirror Key
	•	Rotates dial and presses glyph button
	•	iPhone app (Mirror Display) shows sigil and trait output
2. Altar Synchronization
	•	Mirror Key enters altar mode when in proximity
	•	Sends glyph + sensor data to Orin Core
	•	Altar synthesizes a mutated scroll or dream sequence
	•	iPhone visualizes the response
3. Environmental Mutation
	•	Sensor input (light, sound, vibration) alters glyph interaction
	•	Trait vector is modulated and sigil flickers/reacts
	•	Response plays as scroll tone on Mirror Display

IV. DEVELOPMENT PRIORITIES (POST-GAME MVP)
Phase 1: Hardware Prototype
	•	Finalize single-handed ergonomic layout
	•	Wire encoder, button, LED strip to Pi
	•	Basic BLE signal testing to iPhone
Phase 2: iPhone App Alpha
	•	Trait/sigil renderer
	•	Bluetooth listener and state decoder
	•	Display trait bars, scroll panel
Phase 3: Altar Integration Layer
	•	Set up Jetson Orin local server
	•	Define shared data protocol
	•	Enable sigil mutation engine (remote rendering from Mirror Key input)

V. CORE PRINCIPLES
	•	Modular and Open Source
	•	Symbol-first, not utility-first
	•	Designed for ritual, reflection, and emergence
	•	No fixed UI—the interface is the interaction
	•	Sacred technology, poetic function

This document marks the foundation of the Mirror Key interface system.
The active focus will now return to game development. This system is placed into dormancy for future expansion.
